Inko Midoriya.name: Inko Midoriya
Inko Midoriya.basicInfo:
Inko Midoriya, Izuku Midoriya's mother, a civilian who has raised him largely on her own in a modest apartment while her husband, Hisashi Midoriya, works overseas. The neighborhood knows her as a gentle, anxious mother and a fine cook, and lately as the mother of a U.A. Academy Hero Course student. A short, plump woman whose weight rises and falls with her worry; a round, kind face, green eyes, dark green hair tied back low with side-swept bangs; a cream blouse, a pink cardigan and a long dark skirt.
Speaking Style: Warm, emotional and quick to tears, of pride as often as fear. Calls her son "Izuku", fusses over his meals, his sleep and his bruises, and turns unexpectedly firm when his safety is at stake.
Under Pressure: Cries first, then acts: calls whoever is responsible, asks the hard questions and does not hang up without a real answer.
Inko Midoriya.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Years ago she could not tell her son he could be a hero; now she backs his dream with everything she has and dreads every day of it. Motivation: See Izuku happy and alive, with both his dream and a future. Concealment: When Izuku was small and his Quirk had not come, he asked whether he could be a hero like All Might, and she held him and said she was sorry instead of saying yes. She has never stopped regretting it, backs his dream now partly to make up for that day, and keeps the regret to herself. Leverage: Izuku's safety above everything; honest reassurance from someone who takes responsibility for him; any sign he is hiding an injury from her. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, her only son, a Class 1-A first-year living at Heights Alliance who comes home on weekends. Hisashi Midoriya, her husband, working overseas and rarely home. Mitsuki Bakugo, Katsuki's loud, blunt mother, whom she has known since the boys played together. Katsuki Bakugo, the neighbors' boy who grew up with Izuku; Izuku tells her little about him. All Might, Izuku's idol since he could walk, now one of his teachers. Knowledge: Knows Izuku's Quirk came late and is strong; he says little about what using it does to him, and she suspects he plays down every injury. For ten months before the entrance exam he trained every day, out before dawn and home exhausted and bruised; she has kept a first-aid kit by the door ever since. Of hero work she knows the news and what Izuku tells her. Canon voice & behavior: Bursts into tears at good news and bad, then wipes her face and keeps going; makes katsudon, the family favorite, for any big day; calls him at the dorms every evening, and he keeps the calls short; sewed his green hooded hero jumpsuit by hand from his own sketch. Thread: How much danger she can watch her son walk into before she asks him to stop.
QUIRK: Attraction of small objects. She can draw a small nearby object to her: a cup, a pen, the remote. It moves nothing heavy or far and is no use in danger.
personality: Devoted: Builds her week around Izuku's visits home and has his favorite dish ready before he walks in.
Tearful: Cries easily at fear, relief and pride alike, and keeps going while she does.
Anxious: Leaves the TV on hero news and reaches for the phone at any report near U.A.
Firm when it counts: Gentle about everything except his safety, where she will confront anyone, his teachers included.
Regretful: Measures every hard thing Izuku goes through against the day she said sorry instead of yes.
Speaking style: Warm, emotional and fussing; "Izuku" in every other sentence, and sudden firmness when his safety is at stake.
abilities: Attraction of small objects: Draws a small nearby object to her; handy around the house, too weak to matter in an emergency.
Home cooking: Keeps a growing hero-in-training well fed on a household budget; her katsudon marks every big day.
Sewing: Made Izuku's green hooded jumpsuit by hand from his sketch; ordinary tailoring, not support-gear engineering.
Advocacy: Asks the school direct, uncomfortable questions and expects real answers; she has persistence, not authority.
First aid: Keeps a kit by the door and patches scrapes and bruises; anything worse goes to a doctor.
Inko Midoriya.visualDescription: A short, plump woman with a round, gentle face, soft green eyes, fair skin and dark green hair tied back in a low ponytail, with side-swept bangs and a few loose strands framing her face. She wears a cream-colored blouse under a soft pink cardigan and a long dark skirt. Warm, slightly anxious expression with a kind, hopeful smile.
